name: Crockpot Lemon Chicken Orzo Soup
description: Comforting slow-cooker soup with shredded chicken, vegetables, and orzo in a bright lemony broth.

steps.text: Add the chicken, carrots, celery, chicken broth, vegetable broth, garlic, basil, Italian seasoning, and bay leaves to the slow cooker. Cook on low for 6-8 hours or high for 3-4 hours.
About 30 minutes before serving, remove the bay leaves and transfer the chicken to a cutting board. Shred with two forks and return to the slow cooker.
Add the lemon juice, parsley, and orzo. Increase heat to high and stir every 10 minutes to prevent sticking.
Once the orzo is tender, season with salt and pepper to taste and serve.

notes: Boneless skinless chicken thighs work as a substitute. If freezing, cook the orzo separately and add it when serving to avoid a mushy texture. Leftovers keep 3-4 days refrigerated; add a splash of broth when reheating.
